caption: The drawing depicts a metal teapot with a curved, elongated spout on the right and a handle on the left. The teapot is primarily dark in color, likely black or a very dark gray. It is decorated with floral patterns that include two large red flowers with yellow accents, accompanied by green leaves and smaller floral elements in yellow and green. There are additional yellow decorative patterns along the upper and lower edges of the teapot, as well as on the lid and around the base, which match the floral theme. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, making the colors and details of the teapot the focal point of the composition.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
